entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: About the actualization...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Did something happen?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: One of my fellow artists no longer[n]works in the medium.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: You mean they gave up painting?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: To be precise, their entire history[n]and existence as a painter are[n]no more.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: For real!?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Actualization sure is some spooky[n]stuff...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But doesn't that mean Maruki[n]just killed their dream?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: No—in this reality, they have[n]apparently always been in[n]archery.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: They're quite skilled as well,[n]from what I've gathered.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Seriously? But... why archery?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I don't know the exact reasoning,[n]but it was most likely Maruki's[n]judgment call.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: He pried into your associate's[n]cognition and concluded archery[n]to be the best fit for them.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: So that's what Dr. Maruki[n]considers "salvation"...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: He probably concluded that[n]the arts were just generating[n]suffering for them...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I suppose he thought this would[n]be a superior path?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Now that you mention it, they did[n]say before that they were stuck in[n]a terrible slump...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: But doesn't that mean all of the[n]effort up until now is just...[n]wasted?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Protecting people from their pain[n]must matter more than their lost[n]efforts.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: From his point of view, of course.
A real utopia...
What a hellhole.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It may be to them... but not to me.[n]I could never live with myself[n]like that.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I couldn't have put it better myself.[n]It's so pretentious, it's nauseating.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Throwing away your past to live in[n]blissful ignorance...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Yeah, I could never live like that either.
